description: Keeps a second appliance updated nightly and ready to take over through a guided Promote. Independent of Vibe Backup.

required.name: VIBE_STANDBY_APPLIANCE_DIR
required.doc: Read-only mount of /opt/vibe: the capture source on the primary.

required.name: VIBE_STANDBY_LOCAL_DIR
required.doc: This box's own identity, role and history. Never replicated and never overwritten by a restore.

optional.name: VIBE_STANDBY_TZ
optional.doc: Firm timezone for the capture and sync times. Defaults to UTC.

optional.name: VIBE_STANDBY_CAPTURE_AT
optional.doc: Nightly capture time on the primary, HH:MM. Default 02:30, after Vibe Backup's 01:30 window.

optional.name: VIBE_STANDBY_SYNC_FALLBACK_AT
optional.doc: Time the standby polls for a new snapshot if no notice arrived, HH:MM. Default 04:00.

optional.name: VIBE_STANDBY_STALE_AFTER_HOURS
optional.doc: Hours without a verified sync before the standby is marked stale. Default 36.

optional.name: VIBE_STANDBY_ARCHIVE_DAYS
optional.doc: Days the pre-rejoin archive is kept. Default 14.

optional.name: VIBE_STANDBY_ALERT_EMAIL
optional.doc: Where sync and role alerts are sent. Empty means console only.

_doc: Source of truth for the vendored copy at Vibe-Appliance console/manifests/vibe-standby.json. Appliance integration also needs apps/vibe-standby.yml and env-templates/per-app/vibe-standby.env.tmpl (both in deploy/ here). userFacing false and no subdomains[] means no Caddy surface: the UI authenticates nobody and is reachable only through the console's authenticated proxy at /admin/apps/vibe-standby/. No database or redis blocks: the service owns neither and must keep running when the apps are stopped.
